required_before_execution: Restore and verify exact baseline tree.
Verify patch hash and isolated application; establish candidate tree.
Persist the exact candidate source and a concrete bounded test plan; read back before long-running work.
planned_checks: Focused real odd_sequence and sequence_changed retry behavior, with both calls charged to the original attempt budget.
Verify no retry for unrelated outcomes, no repeated reset after another acceptance, and genuine attempt diagnostics.
Run only explicitly scoped compatibility and native checks with recorded exit and source guards.

outcome_rules.passed: Only when the exact planned check completes with sufficient retained evidence.
outcome_rules.failed: A check completed and demonstrably failed.
outcome_rules.unknown: An attempted check was interrupted or its outcome is not established.

excluded_claims: New-build strict replay passed without running it
